versions.content: {DRAFT} Upon reception of a SYNC (or OFS) message, if • Sequence Counter check is enabled (i.e., CanTSynGlobalTimeSequence- CounterJumpWidth > 0) • and the Time Domain is in timeout (i.e., TIMEOUT bit set in Time Base synchro- nization status timeBaseStatus ) • and the Sequence Counter is stuck, i.e., the value of the difference between the Sequence Counter of the current message and the Sequence Counter of the previous SYNC (or respectively OFS) message is 0, then a Time Slave shall consider Sequence Counter jump as invalid.
